name: Dear Rosalia
source:
Bittersweet sapphic longing; the fictionalized and embellished retelling of an autobiographical moment.

[from [url=https://rascaldevworks.itch.io/dear-rosalia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這是女孩子對女孩子的思慕，又甜又苦。故事取材於作者親歷的一個瞬間，又添了些虛構和潤色。

［摘自[url=https://rascaldevworks.itch.io/dear-rosalia]itch.io[/url]］
